name: islands-completion
label: 水果岛、橄榄岛、渔人岛
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for cozy hand-painted isometric farming game. True transparent background, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Warm cream/wood/green palette, light from upper LEFT. Orthographic 2:1 ground plane. Each sprite isolated inside central 65% of its equal grid cell, ample transparent gutters; no shared ground or backdrop. Wide 3 columns one row, exactly THREE miniature destination islands equal visual size. Left: fruit island, peach and plum orchard and watermelon garden, tiny dock. Middle: Mediterranean olive island with silver olive trees, stone cottage and tiny dock. Right: fisherman's island rocky shore, fishing hut, drying nets, lobster pots and tiny dock. No palm trees. Small turquoise shoreline around each, entirely isolated.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for cozy hand-painted isometric farming game. True transparent background, no text, no labels, no grid lines. name: vehicles-return
label: 返程车辆
prompt: Create transparent-background game sprites: FOUR separate vehicles in ONE long horizontal row. Tiny green red-roof locomotive, tiny cream green airplane, tiny wooden sailing cargo ship, tiny blue white fishing trawler. Facing lower right, sunlight upper left. Each sprite VERY SMALL: occupies only 40 percent of its equally spaced cell, empty alpha all around, huge gaps between vehicles. Hand painted isometric fantasy farming game style. Absolutely transparent PNG background, no glow or shadows.

name: crop-stages-1
label: 四阶段作物 wheat / carrot / corn
prompt: Transparent PNG sprite sheet, cozy hand-painted isometric farming game. Exactly 4 columns and 3 rows, 12 separate sprites. Each row is ONE crop over four stages left to right: sprout, young, growing, ripe. Row1 wheat, row2 carrot, row3 corn. All have the SAME small diamond soil bed and same camera and same ground position within each cell; plants grow naturally, maturity changes height only, never zoom. Each entire sprite occupies at most central 55% width and 65% height of its cell, plenty of completely transparent space between cells. Warm upper-left light, detailed organic leaves, 2:1 ground diamond. No writing or grid. True alpha transparent background, no backdrop or glow.
